title: Nutty Tender Indian Pistachios Curry
description: A creamy, nutty shrimp curry thats perfect for a lazy Sunday, featuring ground pistachios for a rich texture and a whisper of coconut.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 4 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and ginger, cooking for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the tomato puree, and reduce the heat to low, simmering for 2 minutes to develop flavor.
Add the garam masala, a pinch of salt and pepper, and mix well.
Stir in the ground pistachios, coating the onions and tomatoes; cook for another minute.
Add the shrimp, cooking until pink and opaque, about 3–4 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer for 5 minutes, allowing the sauce to thicken slightly.
Turn off the heat, garnish with chopped cilantro, and serve immediately with rice or naan.
